```{r}
# ── F.1 User Fee Support ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

summary_data <- mlogit_clean %>%
  distinct(RID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(Zipverified, User.fee_Y.N) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Zipverified) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(n),
    prop  = n / total * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Clean up labels for publication
  mutate(
    Zipverified = factor(Zipverified, 
                         levels = c("Resident", "Tourist"),
                         labels = c("Residents", "Tourists")),
    User.fee_Y.N = factor(User.fee_Y.N,
                          levels = c("Yes", "No"),
                          labels = c("Yes", "No"))
  )

f1 <- ggplot(summary_data, 
             aes(x = User.fee_Y.N, y = prop, fill = Zipverified)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.9), width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0("n = ", n)),
    position = position_dodge(0.9),
    vjust     = 1.4,
    size      = 3,
    color     = "white",
    fontface  = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Residents" = "#c87620",
      "Tourists"  = "#5992c6"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
    limits = c(0, 100),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Would you be willing to support a user fee mechanism to enhance trail management efforts?",
    x     = "",
    y     = "Percentage of respondents (%)",
    fill  = ""
  ) +
theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
theme(
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, 
                                    size = 9, face = "bold"),
    plot.title       = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", 
                                    hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position  = "top",
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

# ── Export at journal quality ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggsave(
  filename = "Figure_F1_UserFeeSupport.tiff",
  plot     = f1,
  width    = 140,      # single column width in mm
  height   = 100,
  units    = "mm",
  dpi      = 300,
  compression = "lzw"  # lossless compression for TIFF
)

# Also save as PDF for vector quality option
ggsave(
  filename = "Figure_F1_UserFeeSupport.pdf",
  plot     = f1,
  width    = 140,
  height   = 100,
  units    = "mm"
)

print(f1)
```
